mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) and declining employment (PAYEMS < 129000) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5% AND PAYEMS < 129000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining housing starts (HOUST < 600), the economy is in a demand shock that reduces consumer and business confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 600, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 220, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600 and residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 350000, it signals a severe demand shock in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 600 AND RSAFS < 350000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
